# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# The calculated trait values
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20251127.RData")

# The UVP6 data including metadata 
load("data/uvp6_CNN_segmentations_morphotraits_20251125.RData")


theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))
source("functions/lipid_pump_toolkit.R")

```

1. Need a column of [sample_id, object_id, depth_bin, sample_volume, if_segmented, structural_carbon, lipid_carbon, total_carbon, lipid_fullness]
2. From this, get abundance and concentrations in each 5m bin  (sum / volume)
3. To get depth integration, multiply each depth bin by 5 and then sum. Can also separately sum the upper 200 m 200-500m and 500m ++ to get epipelagic, upper mesopelagic, sequestration depth
```{r}
cope_carbon <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # exclude LOKI data
  filter(source != "LOKI segmented") %>% 
  # Add some object_id metadata
  left_join(segmented.images %>% 
              select(object_id, sample_id, sample_cruise,
                     Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3,
                     is_size_extrapolated, is_bad_image),
            by = "object_id") %>% 
  # filter out bad image segmentations and extrapolated sizes
  filter(is_size_extrapolated == F &
           is_bad_image == F) %>% 
  
  # TODO some of the manually segmented images have no lipid content, fix this in the calculate_traits_from_images file.
  filter(!is.na(waxester_carbon)) %>% 
  select(-c(is_size_extrapolated, is_bad_image))
  



# Integrate to 100 m  bins - could be 50 m at surface?  
# Note that the volumes are totaled here (i.e., not averaging the 5m bin vlaues)
binsize <- 100
# Set the depthBinLabel factors ... applied to Ecopart volume!
# TODO Apply to ecopart volumes!!!
dbs <- all.copepods.uvp6 %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # Calculate volumes
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  
  # Add labels for the depth bins
  mutate(depthBinLabel = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  # arbitrary assignment of layers
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin >= 200 & depthBin < 500,
                         "mesopelagic", "sequestration")) %>% 
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin < 200, "epipelagic", layer))

cope_carbon_100m <- cope_carbon %>% 
  
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  # TAdd total volume per depth bin
  left_join(dbs, by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate abundance and carbon concentrations per 5 m depth bin
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, depthBin, volume_m3, n5mbins,
           depthBinLabel, layer) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            lipid_carbon = sum(waxester_carbon),
            lipid_fullness_mean = mean(lf_carbon),
            diapause_respiration_mean = mean(respirationRate_ugCday),
            diapause_duration_mean = mean(diapauseDuration_day), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3,
         lipid_carbon_m3 = lipid_carbon / volume_m3,
         # This should practically be lipid_fullness_mean
         percent_lipid_total_carbon = lipid_carbon / total_carbon * 100) %>% 
  
  # lengthen data frame
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance:percent_lipid_total_carbon,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") 


# TODO add carbon values for the copepods without segmentations
# If most of these are at the surface, would be good to visualize that
cope_carbon_others_100m <- other.copepods.traits %>% 
  filter(object_id %notin% cope_carbon$object_id) %>% 
  select(object_id, sample_id, sample_cruise,
         Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3,
         total_carbon = structural_carbon) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # Add total volume per depth bin
  left_join(dbs, by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate abundance and carbon concentrations per 5 m depth bin
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, depthBin, volume_m3, n5mbins,
           depthBinLabel, layer) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3) %>% 
  # Add labels for the depth bins
  mutate(depthBinLabel = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  
  # lengthen data frame
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance:total_carbon_m3,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") 


# cope_carbon_100m <- cope_carbon_100m %>% 
#   left_join(dbs, by = join_by(depthBin, depthBinLabel))
# cope_carbon_others_100m <- cope_carbon_others_100m %>% 
#   left_join(dbs, by = join_by(depthBin, depthBinLabel))

```

## Plot stuff
```{r}
# Select profiles to visualize ... for now don't include shallow casts (<200 m)
profiles_to_plot <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  # filter(Year != 2024) %>% 
  filter(maxSampleDepth > 200)


ggplot(cope_carbon_100m %>% 
         filter(sample_id %in% profiles_to_plot$sample_id) %>% 
         filter(variable %in% c("abundance_m3","total_carbon_m3",
                                "lipid_carbon_m3","lipid_fullness_mean")), 
       aes(y = value, x = as.factor(depthBin))) +
  # geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 4, outlier.size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev,
                   # labels = dbs$depthBinLabel,
                   name = "100 m depth bins") +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free")


ggplot(cope_carbon_100m %>% 
         filter(sample_id %in% profiles_to_plot$sample_id) %>% 
         filter(variable %in% c("lipid_carbon_m3")), 
       aes(y = value, x = as.factor(depthBin))) +
  # geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 4, outlier.size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  coord_flip() +
  # labs(x = "", y = "Abundance (indivs /m3)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev,
                   # labels = dbs$depthBinLabel,
                   name = "100 m depth bins")



# # Lipid fullness mean VS (total lipids/total carbon)
# ggplot(cope_carbon_100m, aes(lipid_fullness_mean, percent_lipid_total_carbon)) +
#   geom_point() +
#   geom_abline() +
#   geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red")


# What is the % of the abundance, total carbon, and lipid carbon below 200? 500?
# Most of the biomass is beyond the epipelagic... a lot of the copepods are already at sequestration depths
sum_layers <- cope_carbon_100m %>% 
  # only makes sense for abundance and concentations
  filter(variable %notin% c("lipid_fullness_mean","diapause_respiration_mean",
                            "diapause_duration_mean","percent_lipid_total_carbon")) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, variable, layer) %>% 
  summarise(sum_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # calculate overall total and percentages represented by layer
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, variable) %>% 
  mutate(total_value = sum(sum_value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(percent_layer = sum_value / total_value * 100)

ggplot(sum_layers %>% 
         filter(sample_id %in% profiles_to_plot$sample_id) %>% 
         filter(variable == "lipid_carbon_m3"),
       aes(x = percent_layer, fill = layer)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue2","gold1","hotpink"))
```

## Plot the carbon distribution segmented vs not segmented images
*IMPORTANT* some inidividual casts can not observe large copepods for 100m chunks
```{r}
# TODO somethings seems to be wrong with the abundance values... too consistent
all_copepods_100m <- cope_carbon_others_100m %>% 
  mutate(source = "not segmented") %>% 
  bind_rows(cope_carbon_100m %>% 
              filter(variable %in% unique(cope_carbon_others_100m$variable)) %>% 
              mutate(source = "segmented"))

# Average across all samples?
AA <- all_copepods_100m %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% profiles_to_plot$sample_id) %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("abundance_m3","total_carbon_m3")) %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, Year, Month),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  filter(Year == 2024) %>% 
  group_by(depthBin, depthBinLabel, variable, layer, source) %>% 
  summarise(value_mean = mean(value, na.rm = T),
            value_sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            value_n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```
